title: 第一卷 第21章 认下大舅哥
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
荣光飞还看上了那几只青蟹，说道：“个头都不小啊。”

    “我也要了。”

    “三十一斤。”

    “阿华兄弟，以后赶海弄到海货，可以直接送到我饭店里来。”

    李华看向张海洋。

    张海洋说道：“看我做什么，还不赶紧答应下来，荣老板是开饭店的，给的是市场价。”

    “我这边可给不了你这个价格。”

    荣光飞递烟：“张老板，不好意思啊，我是见猎心喜，没有要抢你生意的意思。”

    张海洋接过烟，摆摆手：“我不是那小心眼的人。”

    “以后还要劳烦荣老板多照顾生意。”

    “来，这边过秤。”

    李华笑了笑，叹口气，说道：“荣老板，我也很想答应你，可我这腿着去镇上，等走到海货也死的差不多。”

    “除非我再弄到海参这种好货，不然，我是不愿意折腾的。”

    “还是来码头卖货更好。”

    “我倒是建议你和张哥好好合作。”

    “你也看到了，张哥是这个。”

    说着话，他竖起大拇指。

    荣光飞：“没问题，海洋兄弟，以后到码头，我先来你这里挑货。”

    张海洋点点头，笑着应下来。

    一旁。

    竖着耳朵听的老陈，气的一脚踢在水盆上。

    听着隔壁的动静。

    李华笑了。

    张海洋却是眉头一皱，心说以后和老陈，怕是没办法和和气气的做邻居了。

    海货一一过秤。

    大头还是海参，足足有68斤，计算器发出7480元的响声，把阿青惊的嘴巴张开，眼睛瞪圆，还用手挠耳朵，怀疑自己听错了。

    加上几只青蟹，荣光飞从皮包里掏出钱，点出来7888元，交给李华：“小兄弟，发财了哦。”

    李华接过钱。

    把钱点了一遍，确定无误，帮着将海参送到面包车上。

    送走荣光飞，继续过秤。

    虾姑，海螺，石头蟹，小白章等等，这些海货拢共加在一起也卖了不少钱，张海洋一手拿着单子，另一只手对着计算器敲个不停。

    最后摁下个等于号，计算器立刻算出总价是1366元。

    张春妮的大半桶海鲜也卖了不少钱，尤其是十几只海参，个头都不小，卖了千把块钱，加上其他的海货，一共赚了一千四百块钱。

    拿到钱。

    张春妮的手都有些发抖。

    她做梦都不敢想，自己有一天能够赚这么多钱。

    张海洋把钱点好，交给张春妮：“收好。”

    张春妮点点头，回头看了眼站在门口抽烟的李华，分出来七百块钱，说道：“海洋哥，你帮我交给他。”

    张海洋一愣：“为什么？”

    张春妮说道：“今天是他带我去赶海，而且，好些海货，是……是他帮忙才抓到的。”
content_en:
Rong Guangfei also took a fancy to those blue crabs and said, "They are not small."

    "I want it too."

    "Thirty-one pounds."

    "Brother Ahua, if you catch the sea goods from now on, you can send them directly to my hotel."

    Li Hua looked at Zhang Haiyang.

    Zhang Haiyang said: "Look at what I do, if you don't agree quickly, Boss Rong runs a restaurant and the price he gives you is the market price."

    "I can't give you this price."

    Rongguang handed over the cigarette: "Boss Zhang, I'm sorry, I'm just happy to see you, and I don't mean to steal your business."

    Zhang Haiyang took the cigarette and waved his hand: "I'm not that narrow-minded person."

    "I'll have to trouble Boss Rong to take care of the business from now on."

    "Here, let's get on the scale."

    Li Hua smiled, sighed, and said, "Boss Rong, I really want to promise you, but if I go to the town on my legs, I will be dead by the time I reach the sea."

    "Unless I get good stuff like sea cucumbers again, I won't bother."

    "It's better to come to the dock to sell goods."

    "I would rather suggest that you cooperate well with Brother Zhang."

    "You also saw that Brother Zhang is like this."

    As he spoke, he gave a thumbs up.

    Rong Guangfei: "No problem, Brother Haiyang. When we get to the dock from now on, I will come to you to pick the goods first."

    Zhang Haiyang nodded and responded with a smile.

    aside.

    Lao Chen, who listened carefully, kicked the basin angrily.

    Listen to what's going on next door.

    Li Hua smiled.

    Zhang Haiyang frowned, thinking that he and Lao Chen might not be able to be harmonious neighbors in the future.

    The seafood was weighed one by one.

    The big head was still a sea cucumber, weighing a full 68 kilograms. The calculator made a sound of 7,480 yuan. Ah Qing's mouth opened in shock, his eyes widened, and he scratched his ears with his hands, suspecting that he had heard wrongly.

    After adding a few blue crabs, Rong Guangfei took out the money from his wallet, counted out 7,888 yuan, and handed it to Li Hua: "Little brother, you are rich."

    Li Hua took the money.

    After counting the money to make sure it was correct, he helped deliver the sea cucumber to the van.

    Send Rong Guangfei off and continue weighing.

    Shrimp nuggets, conch, stone crabs, small white seals, etc., all these seafood were sold for a lot of money. Zhang Haiyang held the list in one hand and kept tapping on the calculator with the other hand.

    Finally, press the equal sign, and the calculator immediately calculates the total price to be 1,366 yuan.

    Most of Zhang Chunni's buckets of seafood also sold for a lot of money, especially the dozen or so sea cucumbers, which were quite large and sold for a thousand yuan. Together with other seafood, she made a total of 1,400 yuan.

    Get the money.

    Zhang Chuni's hands were shaking a little.

    She never dreamed that one day she would be able to make so much money.

    Zhang Haiyang counted the money and handed it to Zhang Chuni: "Keep it."

    Zhang Chuni nodded, looked back at Li Hua who was standing at the door smoking, handed out seven hundred yuan, and said, "Brother Haiyang, help me give it to him."

    Zhang Haiyang was stunned: "Why?"

    Zhang Chunni said: "He took me to catch the sea today, and a lot of the sea food was... caught with his help."
